Connor / team — reviewed the floor map and ran a quick acoustic check with Venue Ops on Wednesday. Main notes (summary + required actions):

1) Roundtable audio topology
- Recommended: 12 cardioid boundary mics (one per seat) + 2 ambient ceiling mics for room ambience. Mix to Dante network with a redundant AV BLOB recorder.
- Backup: 4 handheld wireless mics for audience Q&A routed to the FOH console.

2) Video & remote bridge
- Single 1080p60 camera on the head of table (PTZ) + two wide-angle fixed cameras for side capture. Send one clean program feed to the Zoom/Teams bridge (we recommend Zoom Room with SIP fallback).
- Record locally to an ISO recorder (MP4 & separate audio stems) for compliance.

3) Acoustic issues & mitigation
- The main room has reflective glass along the west wall (entrance side). Recommend temporary acoustic baffles along the glass and a thick rug under the roundtable to dampen slap echoes. Venue Ops confirmed baffles available for rent.

4) Timeline for tech run
- AV load-in & configuration: 07:00–09:30 day-of. Soundcheck with execs: 08:15–08:45 (short run through).
- Engineer arrival: 06:45 (setup buffer).

5) Power & redundancy
- Mains are shared; request venue provision a UPS for the AV rack and a dedicated 20A circuit for the FOH console.

I attached the acoustic plan I sketched after the walkthrough. Laura — can you confirm logistics for the baffle placement and staged delivery? Sara — if Acme wants the baffles closer to the table, we should sign off now so Venue Ops can order.

Marcus Lin
AV Systems Engineer | Redwood Inference
